services.desc: OGA’s All Star Program was created with the belief that all students deserve the opportunity to have a positive gymnastics experience. Our All Star coaches work to accommodate all needs with patience and care, while promoting confidence and independence in each student. Classes are designed on an individual basis to help students learn and achieve goals while having fun in a social setting. Our unique equipment aids in facilitating the development of motor skills, including jumping, coordination, balance, and body awareness.
